subject.title: [Bug]: TUI /new stopped emitting hook-visible new-session behavior after 46008178d

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100241 as the canonical fix for this issue, or reject it and request a narrower replacement?
rationale: Current main is still broken and the active fix is proof-positive and mergeable, but it intentionally changes TUI session lifecycle behavior and carries a maintainer label, so cleanup automation should not open a competing fix or close the issue before that PR is decided.

options.title: Use the active shared-lifecycle PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100241 if maintainers accept the stricter TUI lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Request a narrower replacement
options.body: Close or pause the active PR and ask for a smaller fix only if maintainers want to preserve the old local empty-session rollover semantics.

recommendation.title: Use the active shared-lifecycle PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100241 if maintainers accept the stricter TUI lifecycle behavior.
